nodes.summary: For a finite abelian group $G$ and functions $f, g, h : G \to \mathbb{C}$, we have $(f * g) * h = f * (g * h)$, where the convolution is $(f * g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\,g(x - y)$.
nodes.title: Convolution on a finite abelian group is associative

nodes.summary: For a finite abelian group $G$ and functions $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$, we have $f * g = g * f$, where the convolution is $(f * g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\,g(x - y)$.
nodes.title: Convolution on a finite abelian group is commutative

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $\delta_0 : G \to \mathbb{C}$ be the function with $\delta_0(0) = 1$ and $\delta_0(y) = 0$ for $y \ne 0$. Then $\delta_0 * g = g$ for every $g : G \to \mathbb{C}$, where the convolution is $(f * g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\,g(x - y)$.
nodes.title: The delta function is a left identity for convolution

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group. The convolution of functions $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$ is the function $f * g : G \to \mathbb{C}$ given by $(f * g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\,g(x - y)$, with no normalizing factor $1/|G|$, where $|G|$ is the number of elements of $G$.
nodes.title: Convolution on a finite abelian group

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and, for $u : G \to \mathbb{C}$ and real $s > 0$, write $\|u\|_s = \left(\sum_{x \in G} |u(x)|^s\right)^{1/s}$. Let $f, g : G \to \mathbb{C}$ and let $p, q, r$ be real numbers with $p > 1$, $q > 1$, $r > 1$ and $1/p + 1/q = 1 + 1/r$. Then the convolution $(f * g)(x) = \sum_{y \in G} f(y)\,g(x - y)$ satisfies $\|f * g\|_r \le \|f\|_p \, \|g\|_q$.
nodes.title: Young's convolution inequality on a finite abelian group
